column1: # zrecast — the names that are answered, and how.
# SYMBOL<TAB>VERDICT<TAB>EVIDENCE, one line per public Recast/Detour name that
# is not a gap. This is the only hand-maintained half of the coverage record:
# tools/record.sh joins it with the upstream harvest and tools/tranches.awk to
# write tools/unbound_*.txt, and ci/check-coverage.sh then checks every line of
# Binding a name is one line appended here. The verdicts:
#   BOUND      a zrecast entry point a host can call to get the capability
#   EXTENSION  zrecast offers it in a shape upstream does not have
#   LANGUAGE   Zig spells it directly; the evidence names the facility
#   INTERNAL   upstream marks it internal; tools/classify.sh must agree
# Evidence is prose that has to survive a check: BOUND and EXTENSION name a
# symbol ffi/*.h declares, LANGUAGE names a facility from a closed list, ZIG
# names a declaration that exists, and INTERNAL must match what classify.sh
